verdict.rationale: Trivy is a vulnerability/config scanner, not an AI agent with its own tool-use loop that could consume external MCP servers; the evidence shows Trivy ships an MCP *server* (trivy-mcp) exposing its own scanning tools to AI clients like VS Code/Copilot, which is the inverse relationship (Trivy as server, not client). There is no agentic core in Trivy that would 'plug in' other MCP servers to use their tools, so this client-side axis is a category error for this product.
